🚀 极简入门工作流合集

—— 删繁就简，让每一位新手都能轻松跑通

这是一套专门为新手打造的工作流合集。我秉持“极简”原则，尽可能减少了扩展节点的使用，并去掉了复杂的逻辑嵌套。旨在让每一位刚接触该模型的新手都能顺利跑通，并为后续的进阶学习打下清晰的基础。

✨ Key Features / 核心亮点

  • Ultra-Lean / 极致精简

    • 使用极少的扩展节点，安装补齐更简单。

  • Transparent Logic / 逻辑透明

    • 没有复杂的节点分组，数据流向清晰明了，一眼看懂逻辑。

  • Beginner Friendly / 新手至上

    • 专为“第一次运行”设计，不绕弯路。

  • Clean Layout / 布局整洁

    • 模块化布局，拒绝乱如麻的连接线。

💻 Requirements / 硬件要求

  • VRAM / 显存: 16GB

    • 建议显存16G及以上以确保流畅运行。

    • 推荐环境：ComfyUI 最新版。

🛠️ How to Use / 使用指南

  1. Update

    • 更新：确保你的 ComfyUI 处于最新版本。

    • 补齐节点：使用 Manager 插件点击“安装缺失节点”即可自动补齐。

    • 模型路径：确保模型已放置在对应的路径下。

    • 开始使用：直接将 JSON 文件拖入即可开始创作。

✉️ Author's Note / 作者的话

[EN]

我深知新手面对“乱如麻”的节点时的困惑。希望这个清爽的起点能让你专注于创作，而非排查错误。如果你觉得好用，请给我一个五星好评或分享你的返图！

—— Designed for Simplicity, Built for Beginners

📖 Description / 简介

[EN]This is a collection of essential workflows. My goal was to create the most intuitive and clean experience possible. By minimizing the use of custom nodes and avoiding complex grouping, I’ve ensured that anyone new to this model can run it successfully and build a solid foundation for more advanced setups later.

[CN]

  • : Minimal custom nodes; easy to install and maintain.

  • : No messy groups; the data flow is visible and easy to understand.

  • : Perfect for your "first run" with Flux2Klein.

  • : Organized modular design for a clutter-free workspace.

  • minimum for a smooth experience.

  • Environment: Latest ComfyUI version recommended.

  1. : Ensure your ComfyUI is up to date.

  2. Missing Nodes: UseComfyUI-Manager->Install Missing Custom Nodes.

  3. Model Path: Place Flux2Klein models in the correctcheckpointsorunetfolders.

  4. Drag & Drop: Drag the JSON file into ComfyUI and start creating!

I know how overwhelming a "spaghetti" of nodes can be. I hope this clean starting point helps you focus on creativity rather than troubleshooting. If you like it, please leave a star or share your images!
